high_level_description: The image is a slide from a presentation at the Reinforcement Learning Conference (RLC). The slide is titled "The Big World Perspective: The world is much bigger and more complex than the agent." It discusses the challenges and implications of applying reinforcement learning to environments that are significantly larger and more complex than the agents themselves. Title: "The Big World Perspective: The world is much bigger and more complex than the agent" Main Points: Nothing the agent learns can be exactly correct or optimal; everything must be approximate.
